Question 1
?

Construct the vector field that has the stream function ψ(x,y)=y2−x2+x.

a
F(x,y)=(y+1)i−x2j
b
F(x,y)=y2i+(x2−x)j
c
F(x,y)=(−2x+1)i+2yj
d
F(x,y)=(2y+x)i+2xj
e
F(x,y)=2yi+(2x−1)j
